textRuns.value: Live Eurostat data. Years differ by indicator because Eurostat reporting lags; coverage is anchored on the most recent year with a complete population denominator.

Regional coverage is OBSERVED, not allocated. Verified for 12 countries against national totals, and effectively ends in 2015. The population denominator is a 2023 snapshot, so rates are indicative rather than same-year.
Six member states publish NO nurse data at all (BG, CY, LU, PL, PT, SE). Any EU-wide nurse total including them understates coverage by about a fifth of the member states.
The hospital risk score weights are stated ASSUMPTIONS, not fitted parameters. They need domain review before informing a funding decision.

Seven model families were compared on one task under identical walk-forward validation. ARIMA won at 4.99% MAPE. Every tree-based model lost to the naive baseline, because short near-linear series cannot be extrapolated past a training range.
